title: 10. Exercises: Day 17 — Advanced Workflows
summary: Add meetings to PlannerState. In schedule_node, before assigning a task to a slot, check that [start, end) does not overlap any meeting interval.
objectives: Solve the Day 17 — Advanced Workflows exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
1. **Add a calendar-conflict check.** Modify `schedule_node` to accept a `meetings: list[dict]` field (each with start/end), and skip scheduled task slots that overlap. Tasks should fill in the gaps.

<details>
<summary>Hint</summary>

Add `meetings` to `PlannerState`. In `schedule_node`, before assigning a task to a slot, check that `[start, end)` does not overlap any meeting interval. If it does, push `cursor` past the meeting end. Sort meetings by start time first so the cursor-advance logic is straightforward.
</details>

2. **Replace the deterministic prioritizer with an LLM node.** Compare the output of the heuristic vs the LLM across three different task sets. Which is more "sensible"? Which is cheaper?

<details>
<summary>Hint</summary>

Define `prioritize_llm_node` that calls `llm.with_structured_output(PrioritizationResult)` where the schema is `list[{name, score, rationale}]`. Run both versions on the same input. The LLM will produce more nuanced reasoning but cost ~5x more and take 1-2 seconds longer. The heuristic is right 80% of the time and free.
</details>

3. **Make the weekly report configurable.** Add a `team: str` parameter and pull per-team data from the mock store. Verify the agent handles teams with no data gracefully (empty highlights, zero totals).

<details>
<summary>Hint</summary>

Add `deps_type=TeamDeps` to the agent where `TeamDeps` is a Pydantic model holding a `team: str` field. Pass `deps=TeamDeps(team="platform")` to `run_sync`. In the tools, read `ctx.deps.team` and look up `MOCK_WEEK_BY_TEAM[team]` instead of the global. Return empty activity for unknown teams and let the LLM write "No activity recorded for team X this week."
</details>
